EU-LOB: European Union Lobbying Organizations Database

eulob-package.Rd

Provides tools for accessing and exploring a bundled catalogue of registered lobbying organizations in the European Union.

Details

The catalogue covers 19 territorial scopes and 21 registers, including the supranational EU Transparency Register. The Netherlands is not included in the searchable catalogue because its available historical records do not support reliable identification of lobbying entities.

The catalogue distinguishes normalized organization names from register-specific entity identifiers. Records are not globally deduplicated legal entities.

Data are stored locally and can be queried without an internet connection.

Main functions

  • eulob_countries(): Territorial coverage.

  • eulob_registers(): Available registers.

  • eulob_lobbies(): Name and identifier records.

  • eulob_search(): Search organization names.

  • eulob_cross_registers(): Shared names across registers.

  • eulob_info(): Project metadata.

  • eulob_version(): Package version.
